latvia.description: Vitézy Dávid szerint nem szégyen kölcsönkérni, amíg az EU-s pénzekből nem vesznek új vonatokat, és amúgy is az előző kormány hibája, hogy a Dunakeszi Járműjavítóban ragadtak a MÁV kocsijai.

latvia.title: Szilágyi Liliána apját a Magyar Olimpiai Bizottság tagjává választották
latvia.description: Miközben a Magyar Úszó Szövetség korábban a bántalmazások miatt nem kívánatos személynek nyilvánította.

latvia.title: Luigi Mangione ügyvédei mégsem fognak az emberöléssel vádolt férfi pszichiátriai állapotával érvelni
latvia.description: A férfi ugyanis tagadja az UnitedHealthcare vezérigazgatójának megölését.

latvia.title: Csak a szokásos: az amerikai védelmi miniszter Brüsszelben fenyegette az európaiakat, hogy ha nem költenek eleget védelemre, az USA csökkenti a katonai jelenlétét
latvia.description: Pete Hegseth szerint lesznek olyan országok, amelyek elbuknak az USA felülvizsgálatán, és lesznek olyanok is, amelyek kiváló eredménnyel teljesítenek. Sokakat J. D. Vance müncheni kioktatós beszédére emlékeztetett Hegseth kirohanása a brüsszeli NATO központban.

latvia.title: Kolumbia simán verte Üzbegisztánt, Ghána utolsó pillanatos góllal nyomta le Panamát
latvia.description: Egyetlen éjszaka, két vébémeccs.

latvia.title: Magyar Péter szerint most jutott el a magyar nemzet odáig, ahová az 1956-osok el akarták juttatni
latvia.description: Nagy Imrére és mártírtársaira emlékeztek az Országgyűlésben. A felemelő pillanatok után viszont jött a csörte, Orbán Balázst például a világ leggyávább magyarjának nevezte a kormányfő, és felolvasta neki az 56-os mártírok névsorát.

latvia.title: Ezen a nyáron is le lehet vonatozni a horvát tengerpartra
latvia.description: Júliustól indul az Adria InterCity.

latvia.title: Versenyző piacgazdaság nélkül nincs felzárkózás: a magyar modellváltás tétje a következő évtized
latvia.description: Magyarország jelentős gazdasági lehetőség előtt áll, de a felzárkózás nem automatikus. Gyurcsik Attila, az Accord Alapkezelő vezérigazgatója a Portfolio Checklist Extra adásában elmondta, hogy szerinte az elmúlt évtizedek egyik legfontosabb tanulsága, hogy sem a külföldi összeszerelő kapacitásokra építő modell, sem a támogatásokkal és kézi vezérléssel formált hazai vállalati szektor nem hozott tartós versenyképességi fordulatot. A következő időszak kulcskérdése az lehet, hogy Magyarország képes-e valódi, torzításmentes versenyre épülő piacgazdaságot teremteni.

latvia.title: Poland and Germany sign defence cooperation agreement
latvia.description: The two neighbours and NATO allies will increase cooperation in military mobility, logistics infrastructure, maritime security and cybersecurity.

latvia.title: Napätie v Česku. Pavel sa samitu NATO nezúčastní, rozhodla česká vláda
latvia.description: Prezident Petr Pavel napokon na kľúčový júlový summit NATO v Ankare neodcestuje. Českú delegáciu povedie premiér Andrej Babiš s ministrami obrany a diplomacie.

latvia.title: Babiš rozhodol. Prezidenta Pavla na summit NATO neberie
latvia.description: Že by išlo z našej strany o truc alebo že by sme mu niečo zakazovali, nie je to pravda, uviedol Babiš k sporu s prezidentom.

latvia.title: Není to truc, vztahy to nepoškodí, řekl Babiš o zamítnutí Pavlovy účasti v Ankaře
latvia.description: Premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO) si myslí, že případná kompetenční žaloba, o které mluví prezident Petr Pavel kvůli sporu s vládou o účasti na červencovém summitu NATO v Ankaře, nemá smysl. Řekl to po pondělním jednání vlády, kde se kabinet rozhodl prezidenta Petra Pavla na vrcholné jednání nepřizvat.

latvia.title: Hrad ohledně rozhodnutí vlády o summitu NATO mlčí. Vyjádří se v úterý
latvia.description: Zda prezident Petr Pavel přistoupí ke kompetenční žalobě, bude zřejmě jasné v úterý dopoledne. Mluvčí Hradu Vít Kolář řekl Novinkám, že prezidentská kancelář na aktuální rozhodnutí vlády Andreje Babiše (ANO) nevyslat ho na červencový summit NATO v pondělí reagovat nebude.

latvia.title: Rozhodnuto. Vláda s Pavlem na summitu NATO nepočítá
latvia.description: Prezident Petr Pavel podle rozhodnutí vlády nebude součástí delegace na červencovém summitu NATO v Ankaře. Po jednání kabinetu to oznámil premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO), který delegaci povede. Prezident se k záležitosti oficiálně vyjádří v úterý, podle serveru Seznam Zprávy je ale rozhodnutý podat Ústavnímu soudu kompetenční žalobu.

latvia.title: Vláda nepočítá s účastí prezidenta na summitu NATO v Ankaře
latvia.description: Vláda nepočítá s účastí prezidenta Petra Pavla na červencovém summitu NATO v Ankaře. Po jednání kabinetu to oznámil premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO). Dodal, že Česko zastoupí delegace, kterou povede předseda vlády, tedy Babiš, a doplní ji ministr zahraničí Petr Macinka (Motoristé) a ministr obrany Jaromír Zůna (za SPD). Důvody rozhodnutí jsou podle Babiše čistě praktické. Kabinet probral mimo jiné výhled vývoje veřejných financí do roku 2030.

latvia.title: Připravený návrh delegace na summit NATO nepočítá s účastí prezidenta
latvia.description: Ministři obrany Jaromír Zůna (za SPD) a zahraničí Petr Macinka (Motoristé) připravili na pondělní zasedání vlády jen jednu verzi složení delegace na červencový summit NATO, a to s premiérem Andrejem Babišem (ANO) v čele. S účastí prezidenta Petra Pavla nepočítá. Premiér v neděli rozhodnutí předjímat nechtěl. Pavel uvedl, že jde hlavně o to, jestli kabinet může bránit hlavě státu v ústavní pravomoci zastupovat stát navenek.

latvia.title: Scurgeri de gaze la un bloc din Sectorul 3 al Capitalei: au fost evacuați 90 de oameni din cele șase scări ale imobilului
latvia.description: Circa 90 de locatari din cele şase scări ale unui bloc din Sectorul 3 al Capitalei au fost evacuaţi, luni după-amiază, după ce s-au semnalat scurgeri de gaze la o ţeavă care face legătura cu imobilul. Măsurătorile făcute în imobil nu au indicat depăşiri, astfel că locatarilor li se permite să revină în apartamente. Reprezentanţii Distrigaz Sud Reţele au precizat că au întrerupt alimentarea cu gaze în zonă, fiind afectaţi 40 de clienţi din trei scări ale blocului.

latvia.title: Alan Greenspan, cel mai influent guvernator al unei Bănci Centrale din epoca modernă, a murit la vârsta de 100 de ani
latvia.description: Economistul american Allan Greenspan, care a condus Banca Centrală a Statelor Unite timp de aproape douăzeci de ani, a decedat luni, 22 iunie, la vârsta de 100 de ani, scrie Le Monde.

latvia.title: Rusia acuză NATO și UE că pregătesc un nou plan „Barbarossa” pentru a cuceri țara lui Putin
latvia.description: NATO și Uniunea Europeană se pregătesc pentru un conflict militar cu Rusia la începutul anului 2030, iar pregătirile lor seamănă din ce în ce mai mult cu planul „Barbarossa” — strategia Germaniei naziste de a ataca URSS, a declarat adjunctul șefului Ministerului Afacerilor Externe al Federației Ruse, Alexander Grushko.

latvia.title: Peiu susține că Nicușor Dan și PSD presează AUR să voteze Guvernul Veștea: „Asta ar aduce prăbuşirea partidului”
latvia.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a afirmat, într-un mesaj pe rețelele sociale, că președintele Nicușor Dan și PSD pun presiune pe AUR să voteze Guvernul Veștea. Însă acest lucru „ar aduce prăbuşirea” partidului, susține acesta.

latvia.title: De ce crede Ilie Bolojan că Nicușor Dan l-a ales pe Adrian Veștea pentru a forma guvernul: „Veriga slabă”
latvia.description: Președintele PNL, Ilie Bolojan, crede că Adrian Veștea a fost desemnat premier de către șeful statului, Nicușor Dan, pentru că este „veriga slabă”. Declarația a fost făcută la Jurnalul de Seară de la Digi24.

latvia.title: Pariul nuclear fragil al lui Macron: „Planul B” pentru Europa, dacă SUA se retrag din NATO, depinde de votul popular al francezilor
latvia.description: La începutul lunii martie, președintele francez Emmanuel Macron s-a aflat la o bază de submarine de pe coasta bretonă și a îngropat în liniște patru decenii de ortodoxie nucleară franceză. Arsenalul avea să crească. Numărul avea să fie ascuns. Și, pentru prima dată, armele nucleare pe care Franța le-a construit pentru a apăra Parisul ar putea fi desfășurate într-o zi pentru a proteja Berlinul, se arată într-o amplă analiză War on the Rocks.

latvia.title: AUR insistă cu organizarea de alegeri anticipate. Peiu: „Orice guvern votat acum nu face decât să prelungească criza”
latvia.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrișor Peiu, susține că singura soluție pentru ieșirea din criza politică este organizarea de alegeri anticipate. Acesta a afirmat, într-un mesaj postat pe pagina sa de Facebook, că „AUR este primul partid în sondaje și are dreptul să își facă propria politică, nu are de ce să fie la remorca vreunui alt partid”.

latvia.title: Gabriela Horga, propusă ca vicepreședinte PNL în echipa lui Ilie Bolojan: „Îmi asum acest proiect cu seriozitate și responsabilitate”
latvia.description: Senatoarea PNL Gabriela Horga, propusă ca vicepreşedinte în echipa lui Ilie Bolojan, spune că este nevoie de un partid unit, puternic şi credibil, capabil să ofere soluţii reale şi să respecte încrederea oamenilor.

latvia.title: Trump reaprinde temerile privind viitorul NATO. Istoria explică de ce alianța rezistă de opt decenii
latvia.description: De fiecare dată când relațiile dintre Washington și capitalele europene se deteriorează, reapar predicțiile privind sfârșitul NATO. Revenirea lui Donald Trump la Casa Albă, disputele privind Ucraina și Orientul Mijlociu și vechile tensiuni legate de cheltuielile de apărare au alimentat un nou val de pesimism. Istoria alianței arată însă că actuala criză nu este nici pe departe fără precedent, iar interesele comune de securitate care au ținut NATO unită timp de opt decenii continuă să cântărească mai mult decât divergențele dintre aliați, arată o analiză realizată de Foreign Affairs.

latvia.title: BREAKING Petrișor Peiu: Eu mă retrag din prim-planul vieții publice dacă AUR votează guvernul Veștea
latvia.description: Petrișor Peiu, liderul senatorilor AUR, a declarat luni la Antena 3 că ”eu mă retrag din prim-planul vieții publice dacă AUR votează guvernul Veștea”. El a făcut declarația după ce George Simion a început să negocieze cu Adrian Veștea pentru susținerea guvernului. Petrișor Peiu a spus că se va retrage din prim-plan pentru că a […] © G4Media.ro .

latvia.title: Guvernul Cehiei condus de populistul Andrej Babis îl exclude pe președintele Petr Pavel din delegația de la summitul NATO
latvia.description: Guvernul de la Praga a comunicat luni că nu îl va include pe preşedintele Petr Pavel în delegaţia Cehiei la summitul NATO de luna viitoare, transmite Agerpres. Decizia este contrară tradiţiei şi prefigurează o confruntare legală între premierul Andrej Babis si Pavel, fost general de carieră, comandant al armatei cehe şi şef al comitetului militar […] © G4Media.ro .

latvia.title: Pevkur: Ugandi tõestas Eesti mereväe valmisolekut muutuvas julgeolekuolukorras
latvia.description: Kaitseminister Hanno Pevkur andis esmaspäeval Miinisadamas peetud tseremoonial üle rahvusvahelistes sõjalistes operatsioonides osalenu medalid mereväe miinijahtija Ugandi meeskonnale, kes naasis enam kui kolmekuuliselt teenistuselt NATO esimeses alalises miinitõrjegrupis (SNMCMG1).

latvia.title: Rumeenia parlament hääletab täna uue valitsuse üle, kaalul on ka toetus Ukrainale
latvia.description: Rumeenia peaministrikandidaat Adrian Vestea taotleb esmaspäeva hilisõhtul parlamendilt oma kavandatavale valitsusele heakskiitu ning vajab selleks äärmusparempoolse opositsiooni toetust. See võib seada ohtu Bukaresti senise toetuse Ukrainale, vahendab Reuters.

latvia.title: Great Latgalian Market brought together hundreds this year
latvia.description: The Great Latgalian Market has become an important summer tradition in Latgale. To celebrate the summer solstice together, it brings together vendors and visitors from various regions of Latvia every year, Latgale Regional Television reported on June 21.

latvia.title: Many Latvian road signs still point to Russia
latvia.description: On 318 road signs in Latvia, the names Moscow, Vitebsk, or other Russian and Belarusian city names are still visible. An initiative submitted to the government to replace them has not yet been approved, Latvian Television reported on June 21.

latvia.title: Possible medical misconduct case to be reviewed in Latvia
latvia.description: The Ministry of Health’s (VM) planned reform of the hospital network promises to address a long-standing problem – inconsistent quality of care in hospitals. Several cases have come to the ministry's attention in which the quality of care provided was so poor that specialists in Rīga had to correct mistakes made by lower-level hospitals, Latvian Television reported on June 21.

latvia.title: Holidays contribute to drowning statistics again in Latvia
latvia.description: The State Fire and Rescue Service (VUGD) had already recovered the bodies of three people from bodies of water over the weekend as of Sunday, service spokesperson Anete Strazdiņa told the LETA news agency on June 21.

latvia.title: Midsummer week begins warm and sunny in Latvia
latvia.description: Midsummer Week in Latvia will begin with dry and sunny weather, according to a forecast from the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre.

latvia.title: 'Tractor race' in Rēzekne comes to police's attention
latvia.description: For the second year in a row, local business owners in the Rēzekne Municipality have organised the "Tractor Race" event, but this year it has come to the attention of the State Police due to safety violations, LSM's Latgale editorial reported on June 21.

latvia.title: Eagle owlets leave their nests in Latvia
latvia.description: It’s graduation season – not just in schools, but also in meadows and forests. A new generation of birds and animals is leaving their nests and dens. The little eagle owls whose nest is livestreamed by the Latvian Fund for Nature have also ventured out into this vast, perilous world.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: 20th Baltic states student song and dance festival 'Gaudeamus' grand concert
latvia.description: From June 19th to 21st, Riga will host the XX Baltic Student Song and Dance Festival “Gaudeamus”, bringing together 5,000 students from Latvia, Lithuania and Estonia.

latvia.title: Longest day of year in Latvia will be hot
latvia.description: The longest day of the year, Sunday, June 21, will be hot, with thunderstorms in the afternoon, according to the Latvian Environment, Geology and Meteorology Centre.

latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Police keep an eye on roads during holidays in Latvia
latvia.description: Law enforcement officers will be conducting increased patrols on the roads until June 28, with a particular focus on checking for drunk driving, LSM's Latgale editorial reports.

latvia.description: More exciting action as Latvia and Switzerland meet in an international volleyball clash.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia versus Greece women's international volleyball
latvia.description: Watch live as Latvia takes on Greece in women's international volleyball.

latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia versus Norway men's international volleyball
latvia.description: Watch LTV's live coverage as the national volleyball teams of Latvia and Norway battle it out.

latvia.title: WATCH AGAIN: Latvia versus Estonia women's international volleyball
latvia.description: Watch LTV's live coverage of the Baltic battle as the women's national volleyball teams of Latvia and Estonia battle it out.

latvia.title: Prince of Courland Ernst Johann Biron dies aged 85
latvia.description: Ernst Johann Biron, Prince of Courland (1940–2026), descendant of Duke Peter von Biron of Courland, passed away on the night of June 19 at the age of 85, according to representatives of Rundāle Palace.

latvia.title: Latvian Midsummer 'online film festival' available worldwide
latvia.description: The National Film Center’s filmas.lv portal is hosting its traditional “Midsummer Festival,” which this year is centred on the history of cinema and the music calendar; specifically, 2026 marks more or less 'round number' anniversaries for many well-known Latvian composers who have also written music for great films, and the portal has curated a selection of ten films from the anniversary composers’ filmography.

latvia.title: Traditional Herb Market open in Rīga's Old Town
latvia.description: The traditional Herb Market opened on June 19 in Rīga’s Doma Square, offering everything needed for the colourful and tradition-rich Midsummer celebrations – Midsummer herbs, cheese, beer, and gifts. This year, more than 260 vendors are participating, and the market will be open until 7 p.m.

latvia.title: 'Digital television' case to be reviewed again in court
latvia.description: The Senate’s Criminal Division has reviewed the prosecutor’s appeal and overturned the Riga Regional Court’s ruling, which had found all defendants in the so-called second Digital Television criminal case not guilty and acquitted them. Several individuals were involved in the case, including Rīga City Council member Ainārs Šlesers (Latvia First) and former Prime Minister Andris Šķēle, Latvian Television reports.

latvia.title: Former President Levits receives Germany's highest honour
latvia.description: Latvia's former president Egils Levits has been awarded Germany’s highest honour for his decades-long dedication and services to German-Latvian relations.

latvia.title: Midsummer holiday will be hot in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that the weather in Latvia will be warm during the long holiday weekend, at times even hot and muggy.

latvia.title: Latvian army commander promoted to highest rank
latvia.description: On June 18, President Edgars Rinkēvičs issued an order promoting Kaspars Pudāns, Commander of the National Armed Forces (NBS), to the rank of lieutenant general, according to a statement from the President’s Office.

latvia.title: Extra public transport in Rīga on Midsummer Night
latvia.description: On Midsummer Night (June 23-24), additional public transportation will be available in Rīga, and travel will be free over the holidays, Baiba Bartaševiča-Feldmane, head of the Public Relations Department at "Rīgas satiksme," told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Safety tips ahead of Midsummer holidays in Latvia
latvia.description: The upcoming Midsummer holiday is prompting various services to mobilise, including medical personnel, firefighters, and food safety inspectors. Latvian Radio has compiled a reminder on basic safety tips for the holidays.

latvia.title: Reduced tax on diesel to stay until end of year in Latvia
latvia.description: The reduced excise tax rate on diesel fuel will remain in effect until the end of this year. This is provided for in the amendments to the Law on Limiting Price Increases for Petroleum Products, which the Saeima approved on Thursday, June 18.

latvia.title: Drone-related crimes to be punished more strictly in Latvia
latvia.description: On Thursday, June 18, the Saeima approved, in the final reading, amendments to the Criminal Law that strengthen criminal liability for crimes committed using airborne devices, such as balloons, drones, and weather probes, according to a statement from parliament.

latvia.title: Jelgava is on fire this weekend
latvia.description: The 14th International Large-Scale Ceramic Fire Sculpture Symposium is underway in Jelgava, on Pasta (Postal) Island. This year, four artists from Latvia, the United Kingdom, and Estonia are creating large-scale fireclay sculptures on the theme of identity, Zemgale Regional Television reported on June 18.

latvia.title: Russian, Belarusian investors' opportunities to live in Latvia restricted
latvia.description: On Thursday, the Saeima adopted amendments to the Immigration Law in its final reading, which would prevent citizens of Russia and Belarus from obtaining temporary residence permits through the investment program for alternative investment fund managers. LETA reports.

latvia.title: Latvian actor Enriko Avots dies
latvia.description: Latvian actor Enriko Avots (02.11.1952–14.06.2026), who worked at the Youth Theatre from 1976 to 1992 and later at the New Rīga Theatre and Latvian Television, has died, according to the Latvian Theatre Workers’ Union.

latvia.title: Sunny day on Friday in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that Friday will be mostly sunny in Latvia.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 18th June, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Boy missing from Skrīveri, Latvia found
latvia.description: The State Police have successfully located the missing boy born in 2014, the police reported.

latvia.title: Chicken of the woods aplenty in Latvia
latvia.description: The annual hunting season for early spring edible mushrooms has come to an end. However, we still have to wait a little while longer for the start of the chanterelle season. Not to mention the start of the season for boletes and other late-summer mushrooms… What should mushroom-loving Latvians do now? Experienced gourmets know: head out to find some chicken of the wood!

latvia.title: Rīga is increasingly buggy
latvia.description: As Midsummer approaches and summer reaches its peak, urban meadows are in full bloom. This season, 27 habitats for invertebrates will be installed in Rīga to promote biodiversity in the urban environment, according to the Latvian Fund for Nature. Additionally, two more areas will be added to the city’s network of meadows this season.

latvia.title: Solar energy park opens in Tārgale, Ventspils
latvia.description: On Thursday, June 18, the Danish renewable energy developer "European Energy" opened a solar park in Tārgale, Ventspils. The solar park covers a total area of 138 hectares, the company reported.

latvia.title: Negative demographics trend continues in Latvia
latvia.description: In the first four months of this year, 3,642 newborns were registered in Latvia, which is 4.9% or 186 newborns fewer than during the same period in 2025, according to preliminary data released by the Central Statistical Bureau, LETA reports.

latvia.title: Final Latvian parliamentary sitting before summer recess on Thursday
latvia.description: On Thursday, June 18, the Latvian parliament, the Saeima, has its final sitting before summer recess.

latvia.title: Prison sentence for ethnic hate motivated assault in Latvia
latvia.description: The Kurzeme District Court has sentenced two individuals who, in July 2024, got into a conflict with a Ukrainian citizen at a public event in Ventspils Municipality, making hateful remarks related to his nationality and causing moderate bodily injury to other individuals as well, the court said on June 18.

latvia.title: Summer solstice events in Latvia
latvia.description: From peaceful wreath-making to lively outdoor dances – a spectacular program of solstice celebrations is in store across Latvia again this year. To help you navigate the wide range of events, here’s a glimpse into the various festivities.

latvia.title: Limbaži, Latvia has first watermelon harvest of year
latvia.description: It’s customary to see cheese and beer on the Midsummer table, but at the Kantāni gardens in Limbaži Municipality, homegrown watermelons are the centrepiece. Farmers Mareks and Aija Kantāni told Latvian Television’s programme Morning Panorama that the first harvest comes in even before the holiday.

latvia.title: Sea of peonies blossoms in Lielvārde, Latvia
latvia.description: It’s peony season in Latvia. They’re blooming in collectors’ gardens and backyard flower beds. The residents of Lielvārde know that many beautiful flowers can be found right in their own town, in Arta Jefimova’s garden. The 90-year-old woman has been growing peonies for a long time and she even refuses to accept money for the flowers, Latvian Television reported.

latvia.title: Hybrid war exhibition open at Latvian Occupation museum
latvia.description: June 17th marks the 86th anniversary of the day Soviet troops entered Latvia on June 17, 1940, and occupied it. On Wednesday, the Museum of the Occupation of Latvia opened an exhibition prepared by historian Kārlis Dambītis, The Hybrid War Against Latvia, 1939–1940, drawing parallels with current events, Latvian Television reported.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 17th June, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Many employees unhappy with LSM rebranding effort
latvia.description: More than 200 employees of Latvian Public Media (Latvijas Sabiedriskais medijs/LSM) are asking the board to retain the long-established brands "Latvijas Televīzija" (Latvian Television) and "Latvijas Radio" (Latvian Radio) rather than rolling everything into a unified 'LSM' brand in future as is currently planned.

latvia.title: Former Latvian central banker has conviction for buying a bogus Covid certificate upheld

latvia.title: Pet food factory opens in Ventspils, Latvia

lithuania.title: Napätie v Česku. Pavel sa samitu NATO nezúčastní, rozhodla česká vláda
lithuania.description: Prezident Petr Pavel napokon na kľúčový júlový summit NATO v Ankare neodcestuje. Českú delegáciu povedie premiér Andrej Babiš s ministrami obrany a diplomacie.

lithuania.title: Babiš rozhodol. Prezidenta Pavla na summit NATO neberie
lithuania.description: Že by išlo z našej strany o truc alebo že by sme mu niečo zakazovali, nie je to pravda, uviedol Babiš k sporu s prezidentom.

lithuania.title: Není to truc, vztahy to nepoškodí, řekl Babiš o zamítnutí Pavlovy účasti v Ankaře
lithuania.description: Premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO) si myslí, že případná kompetenční žaloba, o které mluví prezident Petr Pavel kvůli sporu s vládou o účasti na červencovém summitu NATO v Ankaře, nemá smysl. Řekl to po pondělním jednání vlády, kde se kabinet rozhodl prezidenta Petra Pavla na vrcholné jednání nepřizvat.

lithuania.title: Hrad ohledně rozhodnutí vlády o summitu NATO mlčí. Vyjádří se v úterý
lithuania.description: Zda prezident Petr Pavel přistoupí ke kompetenční žalobě, bude zřejmě jasné v úterý dopoledne. Mluvčí Hradu Vít Kolář řekl Novinkám, že prezidentská kancelář na aktuální rozhodnutí vlády Andreje Babiše (ANO) nevyslat ho na červencový summit NATO v pondělí reagovat nebude.

lithuania.title: Rozhodnuto. Vláda s Pavlem na summitu NATO nepočítá
lithuania.description: Prezident Petr Pavel podle rozhodnutí vlády nebude součástí delegace na červencovém summitu NATO v Ankaře. Po jednání kabinetu to oznámil premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO), který delegaci povede. Prezident se k záležitosti oficiálně vyjádří v úterý, podle serveru Seznam Zprávy je ale rozhodnutý podat Ústavnímu soudu kompetenční žalobu.

lithuania.title: Vláda nepočítá s účastí prezidenta na summitu NATO v Ankaře
lithuania.description: Vláda nepočítá s účastí prezidenta Petra Pavla na červencovém summitu NATO v Ankaře. Po jednání kabinetu to oznámil premiér Andrej Babiš (ANO). Dodal, že Česko zastoupí delegace, kterou povede předseda vlády, tedy Babiš, a doplní ji ministr zahraničí Petr Macinka (Motoristé) a ministr obrany Jaromír Zůna (za SPD). Důvody rozhodnutí jsou podle Babiše čistě praktické. Kabinet probral mimo jiné výhled vývoje veřejných financí do roku 2030.

lithuania.title: Připravený návrh delegace na summit NATO nepočítá s účastí prezidenta
lithuania.description: Ministři obrany Jaromír Zůna (za SPD) a zahraničí Petr Macinka (Motoristé) připravili na pondělní zasedání vlády jen jednu verzi složení delegace na červencový summit NATO, a to s premiérem Andrejem Babišem (ANO) v čele. S účastí prezidenta Petra Pavla nepočítá. Premiér v neděli rozhodnutí předjímat nechtěl. Pavel uvedl, že jde hlavně o to, jestli kabinet může bránit hlavě státu v ústavní pravomoci zastupovat stát navenek.

lithuania.title: Alan Greenspan, cel mai influent guvernator al unei Bănci Centrale din epoca modernă, a murit la vârsta de 100 de ani
lithuania.description: Economistul american Allan Greenspan, care a condus Banca Centrală a Statelor Unite timp de aproape douăzeci de ani, a decedat luni, 22 iunie, la vârsta de 100 de ani, scrie Le Monde.

lithuania.title: Rusia acuză NATO și UE că pregătesc un nou plan „Barbarossa” pentru a cuceri țara lui Putin
lithuania.description: NATO și Uniunea Europeană se pregătesc pentru un conflict militar cu Rusia la începutul anului 2030, iar pregătirile lor seamănă din ce în ce mai mult cu planul „Barbarossa” — strategia Germaniei naziste de a ataca URSS, a declarat adjunctul șefului Ministerului Afacerilor Externe al Federației Ruse, Alexander Grushko.

lithuania.title: Peiu susține că Nicușor Dan și PSD presează AUR să voteze Guvernul Veștea: „Asta ar aduce prăbuşirea partidului”
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrişor Peiu, a afirmat, într-un mesaj pe rețelele sociale, că președintele Nicușor Dan și PSD pun presiune pe AUR să voteze Guvernul Veștea. Însă acest lucru „ar aduce prăbuşirea” partidului, susține acesta.

lithuania.title: Pariul nuclear fragil al lui Macron: „Planul B” pentru Europa, dacă SUA se retrag din NATO, depinde de votul popular al francezilor
lithuania.description: La începutul lunii martie, președintele francez Emmanuel Macron s-a aflat la o bază de submarine de pe coasta bretonă și a îngropat în liniște patru decenii de ortodoxie nucleară franceză. Arsenalul avea să crească. Numărul avea să fie ascuns. Și, pentru prima dată, armele nucleare pe care Franța le-a construit pentru a apăra Parisul ar putea fi desfășurate într-o zi pentru a proteja Berlinul, se arată într-o amplă analiză War on the Rocks.

lithuania.title: AUR insistă cu organizarea de alegeri anticipate. Peiu: „Orice guvern votat acum nu face decât să prelungească criza”
lithuania.description: Liderul senatorilor AUR, Petrișor Peiu, susține că singura soluție pentru ieșirea din criza politică este organizarea de alegeri anticipate. Acesta a afirmat, într-un mesaj postat pe pagina sa de Facebook, că „AUR este primul partid în sondaje și are dreptul să își facă propria politică, nu are de ce să fie la remorca vreunui alt partid”.

lithuania.title: Gabriela Horga, propusă ca vicepreședinte PNL în echipa lui Ilie Bolojan: „Îmi asum acest proiect cu seriozitate și responsabilitate”
lithuania.description: Senatoarea PNL Gabriela Horga, propusă ca vicepreşedinte în echipa lui Ilie Bolojan, spune că este nevoie de un partid unit, puternic şi credibil, capabil să ofere soluţii reale şi să respecte încrederea oamenilor.

lithuania.title: Trump reaprinde temerile privind viitorul NATO. Istoria explică de ce alianța rezistă de opt decenii
lithuania.description: De fiecare dată când relațiile dintre Washington și capitalele europene se deteriorează, reapar predicțiile privind sfârșitul NATO. Revenirea lui Donald Trump la Casa Albă, disputele privind Ucraina și Orientul Mijlociu și vechile tensiuni legate de cheltuielile de apărare au alimentat un nou val de pesimism. Istoria alianței arată însă că actuala criză nu este nici pe departe fără precedent, iar interesele comune de securitate care au ținut NATO unită timp de opt decenii continuă să cântărească mai mult decât divergențele dintre aliați, arată o analiză realizată de Foreign Affairs.
